mine.title: My MCP key
mine.subtitle: This key connects your AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, and others) to every workspace you belong to. Its role decides what the agent may do.
mine.emptyDetail: The app admin creates a key for each member. You get an email and a notification when yours is ready to claim.
mine.secretWarning: Copy this key now. It is shown once and cannot be seen again, not even by the admin.
mine.askAdmin: Ask the admin for a new key.

setup.title: Setup
setup.detail: Keep the key in an environment variable, then register the MCP server in your agent.
setup.envStep: Store the key in your shell
setup.verify: Then ask the agent to call workspaces_list to check the connection.

admin.title: MCP access
admin.subtitle: Each member has one key that works in all of their workspaces. You create the key, the member claims it, and the secret never shows here.
admin.issued: Key created. The claim link was sent to {{email}}.
admin.issuedNoEmail: Key created. The email was not sent, but {{email}} still gets a portal notification.

dialog.title: Create a key for {{email}}
dialog.detail: The member claims this key themselves. The claim link is valid for 7 days.
dialog.name: Key name
dialog.namePlaceholder: for example Claude Code on my laptop
dialog.toolsHint: Defaults follow the role. You can add or remove tools.
dialog.replaceWarning: This member already has a key. The old key is revoked as soon as the new one is created.

guide.title: Required agent playbook
guide.detail: Your agent must read this playbook through planning_guide before it writes anything. The server refuses writes that break its rules.
